pucRule.title: Illinois disconnection and deferred payment arrangement rules
pucRule.summary: Governs disconnection notice periods, deferred payment arrangements, and reconnection for regulated Illinois utilities.

deferredPaymentArrangement.note: Residential customers may request a deferred payment arrangement on arrears before disconnection.

moratoria.label: Excessive heat protection
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers when a heat advisory or forecast high meets the threshold

authorityRule.title: Meridian Energy voice-agent delegated authority — Illinois
authorityRule.text: Voice agents may agree residual payment arrangements at or above $150 per month in Illinois. Amounts below the floor require credit-officer approval at authority level L2 or above.
